name: Ecological sustainability
description: How food production affects the natural environment — climate, water, land, biodiversity and pollution.

name: Health
description: How a food affects your own health and nutrition.

name: Animal welfare
description: How the animals involved in producing a food are raised and treated.

name: Social sustainability
description: How fairly the people along a food's supply chain are treated.

name: Economic sustainability
description: How a food's production and trade contribute to a fair and resilient economy.
